ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel distribution (dark gray/black) across >95% of the visible ventral surface area; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized only to the extreme distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 38 degrees relative to the medial axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with more pronounced pixel-height irregularities on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on both the trailing edges and leading edges, tapering toward sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized high-contrast (white) pixel clusters at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes, characterized by irregular, roughly circular formations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized fragmentation and high-contrast mineralization (pixel clusters) at the terminal points of both lobes.
